category_title: Students with emotional and behavioural disabilities transitioning to mainstream vocational settings
minimal_context: Ian is sitting in a noisy classroom and is asked to study his textbook.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please open your book and start studying the assigned chapter.

STUDENT: I hate studying, and it's way too loud in this room right now.

TUTOR: Just try to ignore the noise and focus on your work.

STUDENT: I can't! All this noise is making me anxious. I'm not doing this.

TUTOR: You need to complete this studying task today.

STUDENT: I said I'm not doing it! Leave me alone! (Slams the book shut and starts loudly calling out and making noises at the desk)

options.A: Guide the student to methodically tune awareness to each body part, intentionally relaxing from toes to head.
options.B: Implement positive behavioral interventions and supports throughout the student's daily study sessions in the classroom.
options.C: Assign reflective journal entries in which the student writes or draws freely about their study experience.
options.D: Provide a list of all elements the student must perform during the study session, including managing materials.
